name: chord-diagram
title: Chord Diagram
description: Flows between the members of one group, both ways, around a circle: each member an arc sized by all it sends, each ribbon joining two members with ends as wide as what goes each way, lit with its member on hover or focus.

meta.when: Showing exchanges within a set where both directions matter: moves between regions, trade between countries, messages between teams. Keep it to about a dozen members. For flows in one direction through stages use sankey-chart; for links without amounts use network-graph.
